name: code-review-reports
description: Produces a Core Review Report: a structured, evidence-based Markdown audit of a repository scored against Review Criteria supplied at invocation time. Bundles two skills — react-code-review (grounded in Vercel React performance rules and Cognine React coding standards) and node-code-review (grounded in Node.js Best Practices and OWASP Top 10) — sharing one report shape, rubric set, and pre-delivery validation gate.
